central_claim_as_understood: The NR4A3 5' fusion partner is a candidate - not established - stratification variable in EMC: prognosis has a crude pooled magnitude (disease-specific death 7/15 TAF15 vs 6/58 EWSR1) that its own larger cohort defeats by adjusting for tumour size, while treatment response has only a direction (0 of 3-5 TAF15 patients) and can have no magnitude at any denominator; the two questions must not be conflated.

blockers.why_blocking: Wrong committed text in a reference list destined for submission - the one artefact that reaches an outside reader. No instrument covers it: lint_citation_types never reads volume/pages, and lint_citations classes PMID 36563884 as 'unverified_at_baseline' in the provenance ledger, i.e. it checks ORIGIN, not correctness.

p1s.where: S3.2 exclusion table; S3.5 ('Pooling it would give 31/163 = 19.0 %'); S7
p1s.what: Sjogren 2003 carries a named exclusion decision and a named sensitivity calculation but has NO identifier anywhere in the manuscript and no reference-list entry. S7 asserts 'each is traceable to a resolvable identifier (PMID, PMCID, DOI or NCT)'; within the manuscript this source is not. The artifact does carry it (PMID 12598313, PMC1868116, doi 10.1016/S0002-9440(10)63875-8 - verified real: Am J Pathol 2003;162(3):781-92). Coverage gap: lint_citations scans identifiers PRESENT in prose, so a source with no identifier at all is invisible to it.
Suemitsu 2025 is cited with inline PMID 40828003 + doi 10.1002/gcc.70076 (both verified correct) but has no reference-list entry, unlike every other named source.

The committed mutation harness exits RC=1 at the pin: 94 declared mutations, 86 caught, 0 survived, and 8 UN-RUN ('anchor occurs 0 times'). Diagnosis: 5 anchors fail only on line-wrapping (whitespace-normalised count is exactly 1); 3 fail on rewording. The seat re-anchored six and ran the two guard modules directly - ALL SIX CAUGHT - so guard coverage is intact and the defect is confined to the harness. But NOTHING INVOKES IT: it is absent from scripts/preflight.sh and .github/workflows/tests.yml, and pytest will not collect it (no test_ prefix), so its red state is unobservable. Consequently the coverage claims in the two guard files' docstrings ('24 of 24 caught', '36 of 36 ... 22 SINGLE-SITE') are REMEMBERED NUMBERS the runnable harness no longer reproduces - precisely the failure mode its own header says it exists to prevent. The orphaned sites include S3.4/S4.7a's 78 % size cell and the P=.004/P=.032 covariate arm swap, i.e. the defeater machinery the paper says must never be quoted without.
